# Code Anchors: Page Frames

- `src/app/FramedLayout.tsx` — the frame for pages with the main navigation
- `src/app/BottomNav.tsx` — the main navigation, the menu panel with its Stores and Inventory links, and the marked area (#59)
- `src/app/area.ts` — works the marked area out from the start of the path, including the inventory path (#59)
- `src/app/routes.tsx` — places each page in the framed or the full-screen frame (#59)
